name: Hammer curl
summary: Like a biceps curl but with the palm facing in, thumb up.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone, working arm nearest, dumbbell hanging with the palm facing the thigh. Curl to the shoulder with the elbow still, lower slowly.
brief: Stand with the dumbbell hanging, palm facing the thigh. Curl to the shoulder with the elbow still, then lower slowly.
why: From the side the elbow angle gives each curl, so reps are counted.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Swinging the body
faults.tip: Rocking to start the curl means the weight is too heavy.

faults.label: Short range
faults.cue: All the way down each rep
faults.tip: Straighten the arm fully between reps; that is where the brachialis works.

points.t: Still by the side; full range.
